notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored (driver.lock.json authored_by kind model, model_id deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017, run_id wB2-043) and unreviewed (reviewed_by null); no hardware was attached and the hardware backend was never run. The upstream package needs gymnasium, numpy and pygame and was not installed or imported, so the fake backend is the package's own pure Python RawARCEnv (fake.py) with the real 30x30 grid shape and a small synthetic problem table; it was not compared with the upstream environment, and the sim backend (gymnasium.make('ARCLE/RawARCEnv-v0')) was not run. The fake covers reset/step and the two spaces but not ARCLoader, rendering, pygame, the ANSI view or the numpy np_random stream; the fidelity gaps say so. No Limits are declared: the only bounds are the bridge-derived action space (action.selection 0/1 per cell, action.operation 0-11) and ticks (1..10000). The package is simulated R0 with the runtime's software e-stop latch only; the upstream class has no native stop. Two expected warning groups remain: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge's seed only sets the next reset's seed and makes no native call) and five G8.NO_UNIT warnings for the bridge-derived integer/number inputs (seed in reset and seed, action.selection[*], action.operation, ticks in step); declaring actions to add units was avoided because it changes the bridge-derived contract. All capabilities are catalogue classes (cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.seed.v1), so there are no catalogue_requests. gate.digest is the digest the last check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
